scope: Isolated public Stroke synthetic controls through existing test-only sampler and mesh expansion, compared to four retained host-Mesa frames. This does not integrate with production exports or establish device parity.
geometry: A cloned public Stroke receives points, pressures and width; its pen metadata is not changed or used for dispatch. Points are transformed from page coordinates to the fixed capture projection x-128, 128-y. Existing sampler and native-derived mesh functions are extracted verbatim with visibility changes; each of three emitted buffers is required to match native captured VBO bytes exactly. Capture draw metadata is reused only for prototype paint.
paint: Existing SVG prototype uses subdivision 4, source shader approximations and analytic fwidth; SVG rendered with resvg 0.45.1. PDF is MuPDF 1.28.2 SVG-to-PDF conversion, not sdocx direct PDF.
metrics: Native RGBA8 flipped vertically and composited on opaque #fcfcfc; SVG similarly composited. PDF background rectangle #fcfcfc before SVG-to-PDF conversion and rasterized RGB at 256x256. Values are [native support, export support, intersection, union, RGB L1 on union], support means any channel differs from 252 by more than 2. Generic direct PDF is a different generation route. Native RGB is premultiplied; composition uses nearest-integer source-over.

inputs.points: (128,128), (138,128), (148,126); far endpoint (158,126), corresponding to captured positions with x=128+x and y=128-y

reproduction: Run .venv/bin/python tools/montblanc/public-candidate/compare.py from repository root, with pinned ignored fixture, offline Cargo dependencies, resvg, Pillow and PyMuPDF. Temporary files are removed; shared Cargo target is reused.
